title: Felt wargame: retreat, advance after combat, mandatory attack
description: Add combat aftermath logic to wargame.felt and crt.felt. Retreat: DR result forces defender to move 1-2 hexes away from attacker, cannot retreat into enemy ZOC (causes step loss), cannot retreat off map (eliminated). Advance: after DE/DR, attacker may advance into vacated hex. Mandatory attack: units adjacent to enemies MUST attack in combat phase. Step losses: units can take 1-2 step losses before elimination (reduce attack/defense). Road bonus: movement along road hexes costs half (round up).
close_reason: Step losses, retreat validation, mandatory attack, advance after combat, exploitation eligibility added to crt.felt and wargame.felt. Both type-check cleanly.
